name: Techstar Molding
old_description: At Techstar Molding, we strive to lead the custom plastic injection molding industry by delivering exceptional value and superior quality, while remaining fully dedicated to helping our customers succeed. With decades of experience and a hands-on, customer-first approach, we deliver results you can count on!
about:
Techstar Molding operates from Pasadena, Texas, in the Houston metropolitan area. For over 40 years the company has provided custom plastic injection molding services, serving customers ranging from entrepreneurs launching new products to large corporations with established production needs. No founders are named in public materials, and ownership structure is not disclosed.

The company runs a full-service injection molding operation that covers design consulting, rapid prototyping, mold construction, production molding, assembly, packaging, and logistics. Its press lineup spans 150 to 1,000 tons with shot capacities exceeding seven pounds, enabling both low-volume and high-volume runs. Value-added capabilities include insert molding, single- and multi-cavity tooling, manual and automated assembly, finishing, labeling, kitting, and just-in-time or vendor-managed inventory programs.

Techstar serves a diverse industrial base that includes automotive, industrial equipment, agriculture, food service, construction, consumer goods, chemical packaging, HVAC, and oil and gas. The firm works with clients of all sizes, from startups needing prototype parts to established manufacturers requiring sustained production volumes.

Techstar emphasizes a turnkey, customer-first model, describing itself as reliable, responsive, and willing to go the extra mile. The company highlights its American-made production, collaborative engineering approach, and ability to manage projects from concept through delivery as key differentiators.
